payloads.name: LegacyJB
payloads.description: Jailbreak service (TCP 9028) for supported apps such as Homebrew Store and Itemzflow.

payloads.name: Pegasus DL
payloads.description: Direct package downloading on the PS5 with a web interface on port 6970.

payloads.name: PS5 Account Tools
payloads.description: Local account manager with a web interface on port 6769. Offline activation, fake PSN sign-in for features like Remote Play, and avatar changes.

payloads.name: APR Emu Updater
payloads.description: Choose which APR Emu (libSceAmpr.sprx) build each installed game uses, from a web interface on port 6971. Needs NanoDNS on first run and ShadowMountPlus for image-installed games.

payloads.name: PS5SX2
payloads.description: All-in-one payload for PS5SX2, a PCSX2 port for PS5. It combines the helper that jailbreaks the emulator, the installer that keeps it up to date from GitHub, and the disc auto-launcher. Needs kstuff and ShadowMountPlus, plus your own PS2 BIOS in /data/PCSX2/bios and games in /data/PCSX2/games.

payloads.name: PS5 Upload Helper
payloads.description: Console-side helper for the PS5 Upload app on PC, Mac, Android or web. Resumable uploads, package installs, file and game management on port 9120. Enter the 6-digit code it shows in the app to pair. Keep the app and helper on the same version.

payloads.name: ShadowMountPlus
payloads.description: Background auto-mounter that detects, mounts and installs game dumps and images from internal or external storage (UFS, exFAT, PFS). Needs kstuff-lite 1.07 or newer; load at every boot. Settings in /data/shadowmount/config.ini.

payloads.name: PS4Mount
payloads.description: Plays PS4 fake PKGs straight from an exFAT USB drive without installing them. Put the game and update .pkg files in the drive root; it adds them to the home screen. Web panel on port 8770 and in the Media tab. Needs fake PKG support (e.g. etaHEN with kstuff) and kernel log access (klogsrv on port 3232, or no other payload reading /dev/klog). Load after every boot. Tested on firmware 13.20.

payloads.name: Orbit Store (Beta)
payloads.description: A modern PS5 download manager with a native TV app, resumable downloads and phone controls.

inactive.name: Spectrum Library
inactive.description: Native content manager for browsing and downloading supported game files.
